comparison: G minus G-late moves the A/C pair from after the first await to before it without moving branch/call sites; all other instruction bytes, registers and ELF layout are identical. G-private minus G-full-late additionally crosses the late helper; call is re-encoded at its moved PC. S-reg replaces six instructions with NOPs, S-compact skips those six sites via straight-line compaction; helper and both call sites use an audited private ABI.

phase_two.family: GEMM -> signed saturating SPM packing of the full producer output -> dependent second GEMM
phase_two.policy: Execute only validated schedules. When no write is early or staging side effects are unknown, retain serial and compare refusal to serial. Record any case invalid on the frozen backend.
